sn38.14:1.6: Atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etāsaṃ dukkhatānam pariññāyāti || ||

sn38.14:1.11: ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayam paṭipadā etāsam dukkhatānam pariññāyāti || || 6
